entries.title: Psalms 7:1
segments: A song of David, which he sang to the LORD, concerning the words of Cush the Benjamite. O LORD my God, in You I put my trust; save me from all who pursue me, and deliver me,

entries.title: Psalms 7:2
segments: lest he tear my soul like a lion, tearing [it] in pieces, and there is no one to deliver.

entries.title: Psalms 7:3
segments: O LORD my God, if I have done this; if there is iniquity in my hands;

entries.title: Psalms 7:4
segments: if I have rewarded evil to my friend, or if I have delivered my vexer without cause;

entries.title: Psalms 7:5
segments: let the enemy persecute my soul and take [it]; yea, let him trample down my life on the earth and lay my honor in the dust. Selah.

entries.title: Psalms 7:6
segments: Arise, O LORD, in Your anger; lift up Yourself because of the rage of my enemies, and awake for me [to] the judgment which You have commanded.

entries.title: Psalms 7:7
segments: And the congregation of the peoples shall surround You; and over it You will return on high.

entries.title: Psalms 7:8
segments: The LORD shall judge the people; judge me, O LORD, according to my righteousness, and according to my integrity on me.

entries.title: Psalms 7:9
segments: O let the wickedness of the wicked come to an end, but establish the just. For the righteous God tries the minds and hearts.

entries.title: Psalms 7:10
segments: My defense [is] from God, who saves the upright in heart.

entries.title: Psalms 7:11
segments: God judges the righteous, and God is angry with the wicked every day.

entries.title: Psalms 7:12
segments: If he does not turn, He will whet His sword; He has bent His bow and made it ready.

entries.title: Psalms 7:13
segments: Yea, He has fitted for him instruments of death; He will make ready His arrows hotly pursue.

entries.title: Psalms 7:14
segments: Behold, he labors in pain with iniquity, and he has conceived mischief, and has brought forth falsehood.

entries.title: Psalms 7:15
segments: He dug a pit and bored it, and has fallen into the ditch [which] he made.

entries.title: Psalms 7:16
segments: His mischief shall return on his own head, and his violence shall come on his own crown.

entries.title: Psalms 7:17
segments: I will praise the LORD according to His righteousness, and will sing praise to the name of the LORD most high.
